title: 第23章 怎么松松垮垮的第24章 林克路西法尔
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
楼下大厅。
“大小姐，您的眼睛……”
“没事……只是暂时性地瞎掉而已，因为是【序列】的关系，过两天就会长出来的……花耶呢？她怎么样？”
“大小姐请放心，小姐正在楼上。”
“是吗？但我很奇怪，你们为什么不告诉我？花耶丢了这么大的事情，结果我是最后一个知道的？你们什么意思？”
“大小姐请恕罪，因为红月降临的因素，我们难以外出——所以——”
“不用再说了，这件事我会告诉父亲大人，不管你们是他的什么人，要是花耶她真的有什么三长两短，我不会放过你们。”
“是——大小姐——”
很快。
楼梯便传来了脚步声。
咔哒——
卧室的大门被推开了一个缝隙。
光线从外面射进来，隐约地可以看到一个女孩的身影站在门边，双眼之上缠着丝绸的带子。
长长的直直的头发，就像是一个安静而精致的洋娃娃。
“花耶？”
她小声地询问。
林恩：“zzz”
她伸出小手，地摸了摸旁边的衣架，摸到了妹妹那熟悉的裙子。
她终于是下意识地呼了一口气，摇了摇头。
看来应该是已经睡着了。

如果是这样的话。
那还是不要打扰了。
然后她轻轻地合上了卧室的大门，在那黑暗中摸索地脱下了鞋子，整齐地放在一边。
她的眼蒙着纱带。
不过虽然眼睛炸掉了，但好在这里是她自己的家，所以一切也是轻车熟路，只是一想到前不见遇到的那个“大魔”，她依然是下意识地发冷，全身都浮现出了一层鸡皮疙瘩。
“真的是外神么……”
她低声地自语。
然后她轻轻地褪下了自己的圆裙，解开了发带，挂在了妹妹衣服的旁边。
黑暗中。
隐约地能够看到那娇小的身躯。
不过因为妹妹已经熟睡的原因，她也尽量是不让自己发出任何的声音，以免把她吵醒。
……
……
就这样，十几分钟之后。
她简单地洗了一个热水澡之后，便轻手轻脚地爬上了床榻，钻到了被子中，陷在了那柔软的床中，长长的头发散落而下。
和妹妹那卷卷的头发相比，她的头发又长又直，完美地继承了母亲的基因。
但她一时却难以入睡。
躺在那里，对着天花板，她一时间竟是有些呆呆地，心事重重。
但是因为失明的原因，又因为她们的床也确实足够大，所以她也显然没有注意到旁边睡着的花耶，明显要比之前要大了一整圈。
而她再次忍不住想起了几个小时之前的经历。

“汩汩汩——刺啦啦——”
那个恶魔出现在她面前时所发出的扭曲的声音，即便是现在想起来，也让她忍不住地感觉到头皮发麻。手脚冰凉。
因为她发誓，那种声音绝对不是人类的声带能够发出的。
扭曲。
混乱。
content_en:
Downstairs lobby.
"Miss, your eyes..."
"It's okay... I'm just temporarily blind. Because of the [Sequence], it will grow back in two days... Where is Hua? How is she?"
"Please don't worry, Miss. The young lady is upstairs."
"Really? But I'm very strange, why didn't you tell me? Huaye lost such a big thing, but I was the last to know? What do you mean?"
"Miss, please forgive me, because of the red moon coming, it's difficult for us to go out - so -"
"No need to say any more, I will tell my father about this. No matter who you are to him, if there is really something wrong with Huaye, I will not let you go."
"Yes - Miss -"
Soon.
There were footsteps on the stairs.
Click——
The bedroom door was pushed open a gap.
Light came in from the outside, and you could vaguely see the figure of a girl standing by the door, with silk ribbons wrapped around her eyes.
With long straight hair, she looks like a quiet and delicate doll.
"Flower?"
she asked quietly.
Lynn: "zzz"
She stretched out her little hand, touched the clothes hanger next to her, and touched her sister's familiar skirt.
She finally breathed out subconsciously and shook her head.
It seems that he must have fallen asleep.
If that's the case.
Then don't bother me.
Then she gently closed the bedroom door, groped in the darkness and took off her shoes, placing them neatly aside.
Her eyes were covered with gauze.
But even though her eyes were blown off, luckily this was her own home, so everything was familiar. However, when she thought of the "big devil" she had never encountered before, she still shivered subconsciously, and goosebumps appeared all over her body.
"Is he really an alien god..."
She whispered to herself.
Then she gently took off her circular skirt, untied the hair tie, and hung it next to her sister's clothes.
in the dark.
The petite body can be vaguely seen.
But because her sister was already asleep, she tried not to make any noise to avoid waking her up.
…
…
Just like that, ten minutes later.
After she simply took a hot bath, she climbed onto the bed gently, got under the quilt, and sank into the soft bed, with her long hair falling down.
Compared with her sister's curly hair, her hair is long and straight, perfectly inheriting her mother's genes.
But she couldn't sleep for a while.
Lying there, facing the ceiling, she felt a little dazed and worried for a moment.
But because of her blindness, and because their bed was indeed big enough, she obviously didn't notice that the flower sleeping next to her was obviously a whole circle bigger than before.
And once again she couldn't help but think about what she had experienced a few hours ago.
"Grrrrrrrrrr--stab la la la--"
The twisted sound the demon made when he appeared in front of her made her scalp tingle even when she thought about it now. Hands and feet are cold.
Because she swore that that kind of sound was definitely not something that human vocal cords could produce.
distortion.
confusion.
